up: I need a list of distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726624. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID (as molecule_chembl_id), the molecule preferred name (as molecule_name), and the compound record key (as compound_key) if available. Do not sort or limit the results.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS molecule_name, MIN(cr.compound_key) AS compound_key FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726624' GROUP BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name;
